column1: # Simplified Chinese (zh-hans) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms, Chinese
# has one). `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns; the trailing "…" is kept.
# Vocabulary: the terms used in mainland China (文档, 画板, 描边, 色板, 蒙版, 首选项, 快捷键, 默认,

# `zh_hans_is_simplified_and_mainland`), and a row and a column are 行 and 列. Many rows started from
# this project's own zh-hant catalog. Clean-room: translate from the meaning of the English text; no
# proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI may be copied. Product and

column3: 选择文字工具（或按 T），在页面上单击并输入几个字。完成后按 Esc。

column2: Press {key} (or Edit › Undo) to take back the last change. Everything can be undone, so feel free to try things.
column3: 按 {key}（或 编辑 › 撤销）撤销上一次更改。所有操作都可以撤销，放心尝试吧。
